prompt:
A battle background for a side-on JRPG battle scene (the party will stand on the right, monsters on the left; no characters are drawn), in rich high-resolution 2D pixel art. The world is in an endless night: the sun has vanished and people live by lamplight. Setting: at the foot of an immense thousand-year-old tree. Back (top 45%): the colossal gnarled trunk fills most of the upper background, its bark covered in softly glowing blue-green moss and lichen, a dark hollow opening, huge roots arching down into the ground, the night sky and distant canopy visible at the edges. Ground (lower 55%): packed earth and moss crossed by thick roots at the sides and back, small glowing fungi. Light: dim moonlight, the moss giving a faint teal glow, deep shadows between the roots. The ground plane recedes from the bottom edge up to the horizon line at a low 3/4 angle; the middle of the ground (from 55% to 90% of the height, centre and right) is open, fairly flat and uncluttered: space for the battle. Details (rocks, plants, debris) sit at the sides and far away. 
No lantern, no fire in the middle, no people, no monsters, no text, no UI.
Pixel art: every art pixel is 4x4 image pixels (the image is 960 x 540 art pixels), crisp square pixels, no anti-aliasing, hue-shifted colour ramps (shadows toward violet, lights toward warm yellow), clusters with clear shapes, not a painting.
revised_prompt: Create a wide 16:9 side-on JRPG battle BACKGROUND ONLY, high-resolution 2D pixel art, intended as a battle stage with party on right and enemies on left (do not draw any characters). Endless-night fantasy world, vanished sun, at the foot of an immense ancient thousand-year-old tree. Composition: upper approximately 45% dominated by colossal gnarled trunk with massive bark shapes, faintly glowing blue-green moss and lichen, ominous dark hollow, huge roots arching downward into ground, slivers of dark starless night sky and distant canopy at outer edges. Lower approximately 55% is an expansive packed-earth and moss ground plane receding from bottom edge to horizon in low 3/4 perspective. IMPORTANT: centre and right of ground from y=55% to y=90% must be fairly flat, open, clearly walkable and uncluttered for battle sprites; allow left-middle to remain reasonably usable too. Large exposed roots frame sides and rear, not battle space. Tiny bioluminescent mushrooms, stones, debris and plants confined to edges and far background. Dim cool moonlight, extremely subtle teal moss glow, violet-shifted deep shadows between roots, select muted warm-yellow light-shifted highlights but NO apparent light source in ground. Strong readable silhouettes, atmosphere and depth. True deliberately crafted pixel art, crisp hard square pixel clusters and stepped outlines, unified pixel grid, no smooth gradients, no anti-aliasing, no painterly brushstrokes. Pixel scale equivalent to 4x4 display pixels per art pixel; target appearance like 960x540 native art pixels scaled to 3840x2160 using nearest-neighbor. No lantern, no fire, no people, no monsters, no text, no UI.
